title: Route field normalization + main_sha convention + empty folder cleanup
summary: Three classes of pre-m9-11 / mid-m9-11 schema drift: (1) 8 pre-m9-11 cycles had route: 'local' placeholder instead of a real path label; (2) m9-11/12/13 had main_sha set to pre-cycle HEAD (base_sha) instead of post-cycle HEAD (head_sha); (3) one empty cycle folder from an aborted false-positive investigation. Adds cross-check #12.
